scripts.ios: unset FORCE_COLOR; PATH="$PWD/ios/bin:$PATH" TAURI_APP_PATH=ios tauri ios
scripts.sim: unset FORCE_COLOR; S=${SIM:?Set SIM to the ID of a simulator, from xcrun simctl list devices}; PATH="$PWD/ios/bin:$PATH" TAURI_APP_PATH=ios tauri ios build --target aarch64-sim --debug && (xcrun simctl boot $S 2>/dev/null; xcrun simctl install $S ios/gen/apple/build/arm64-sim/Yonder.app && xcrun simctl launch --terminate-running-process $S com.vladartym.yonder)
scripts.install-ios: : ${IPHONE:?Set IPHONE to the ID of the iPhone, from xcrun devicectl list devices} && bun run ios build --target aarch64 --debug && xcrun devicectl device install app --device "$IPHONE" ios/gen/apple/build/arm64/Yonder.ipa
scripts.android: unset FORCE_COLOR; export JAVA_HOME="${JAVA_HOME:-/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home}" ANDROID_HOME="${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Library/Android/sdk}"; export NDK_HOME="${NDK_HOME:-$(ls -d "$ANDROID_HOME"/ndk/* | tail -1)}"; TAURI_APP_PATH=android tauri android
scripts.emu: bun run android build --target aarch64 --debug --apk && A=${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Library/Android/sdk}; E=${EMU:-pushtest}; if ! $A/platform-tools/adb -e get-state >/dev/null 2>&1; then $A/emulator/emulator -list-avds | grep -qx "$E" || { echo "There is no emulator $E. Set EMU to one of: $($A/emulator/emulator -list-avds | tr '\n' ' ')"; exit 1; }; (nohup $A/emulator/emulator -avd $E -no-window -no-boot-anim -gpu swiftshader_indirect >/dev/null 2>&1 &); fi; until [ "$($A/platform-tools/adb -e shell getprop sys.boot_completed 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')" = 1 ]; do sleep 2; done; $A/platform-tools/adb -e install -r android/gen/android/app/build/outputs/apk/universal/debug/app-universal-debug.apk && $A/platform-tools/adb -e shell am start -a android.intent.action.MAIN -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER -n so.yonder/com.vladartym.yonder.MainActivity
scripts.install-android: bun run android build --target aarch64 --debug --apk && A=${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Library/Android/sdk}/platform-tools/adb; $A -d install -r android/gen/android/app/build/outputs/apk/universal/debug/app-universal-debug.apk && $A -d shell am start -a android.intent.action.MAIN -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER -n so.yonder/com.vladartym.yonder.MainActivity
scripts.install-app: bun install && export SENTRY_DSN="${SENTRY_DSN:-$(sed -n 's/^SENTRY_DSN=//p' ~/.config/yonder/.env 2>/dev/null)}" && TAURI_APP_PATH=src-tauri tauri build --config "{\"version\":\"$(bun version.ts)\"}" && (pkill -ax yonder; lsof -a -u $(id -u) -tiTCP:7787 -sTCP:LISTEN | xargs kill 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; rm -rf /Applications/Yonder.app && mv src-tauri/target/release/bundle/macos/Yonder.app /Applications/ && open /Applications/Yonder.app)
